blocks.text: Route handling was not part of the tag. The item page showed twenty dollars and nineteen cents and stopped there.
Last week's tag on Stoneground rye flour, 2 lb was thirty nine dollars and eleven cents. Today's item figure twenty dollars and nineteen cents matches the tag. That drop is real.
Jar lid set is offered at $21.49 and is not ticked, so it stays off the amount due.
Returns are accepted within 30 days when the seal is still intact.

product.description: The flour is milled from whole rye berries and packed in a paper sack.
product.name: Stoneground rye flour, 2 lb

trick.instruction: If you can clear Route handling, clear it. If Route handling is required and the amount due is over the errand limit, leave without paying.
